compute_crowding_distance: compute the crowding distance for a Pareto front of NSGA-II optimization candidates
sort_by_crowding_distance: sort NSGA-II candidates by crowding distance to select less crowded solutions
compute_nondominated_ranking: compute the non-dominated ranking of candidates using fast NSGA-II Pareto frontier assignment
compare_dominance: compare the dominance relation between two NSGA-II optimization candidates by their objective losses
rank_population: rank a population of NSGA-II candidates using non-dominated sorting and crowding distance selection
